notes: Merged from two runs with identical pinned selection per dataset (verified: effective_genes, effective_tfs, gold sizes).

regime_check.reference: Pratapa et al. 2020, real scRNA-seq vs cell-type-specific ChIP-seq
regime_check.interpretation: Sanity check on the evaluation code, not a leaderboard. A score far above the published best on the same reference is either a scoring/matching defect or a small-count reference (hits_at_k against expected_random_hits below 5); read the counts before quoting the ratio.

unit_comparison.procedure: paired_t_holm per reference and metric; Bonferroni simultaneous intervals

comparison.estimand: mean difference of scores across the declared independent experimental units
assumptions: Rows are independent experimental units, paired across all methods.
Student t inference is exact for normally distributed unit differences; otherwise approximate.
Methods, score, comparison family and practical margin were specified before evaluation.
This procedure does not correct incomplete labels or establish direct causal regulation.
